## Rule checklist

- [ ] The rule file is in the correct platform folder
- [ ] I ran `sigma check` on my Mac before pushing
- [ ] The rule has a README note that explains what it detects
- [ ] The README lists the MITRE ATT&CK technique ID
- [ ] The README lists known false positives
- [ ] I tested the rule in my lab and it fires on the attack
- [ ] The rule contains only lab or public data, no work, client or personal data
